notes.title: Patch Notes - v1.0.6 - Adjustments to Stages
notes.content:
Hello Crafters,

We have made several changes to the Stages of Crafty Survivors to reduce the amount of enemies of most of the Stages up to the Desert area and we added a new statue to remove the spawn timer between each enemy for those who want a faster experience. This Statue, however, will make stages harder to complete as enemies will spawn without delay and swarm the area easily.
We've seen the community mentioning that some stages take too long, specially in Malignous mode for those who mostly play on it, so we decided to make some changes on the enemy count for Stages.
We decided not to change the amount of Stages in the game as this will affect progress and saves of all players, so we went into almost every stage of the game to rework the waves of enemies and their amounts.
Some stages were not impacted by this change, as they are later stages in the game, such as the Volcano Area or EX Stages which are meant to be challenges to complete.

Check the Patch Notes below for more detailed information on these changes.

[h1]Patch Notes - v1.0.6[/h1]
[h2]New Statue[/h2]
[h3]Cursed Bait[/h3][list]
[*]Added a new Statue to the Blessing System, available at the Sculptor's Gallery Level 9.
[*]The new Statue removes the Time Between Enemies Spawn, making them all spawn instantly, regardless of difficulty, enemy health and stats.[/list]
[h2]New Accessibility Feature[/h2]
[h3]Remove Malignous Visual Effect[/h3][list]
[*]Added an accessibility option to remove the Malignous Purple Visual Effect for players who find that filter too hard to see.[/list]

[h2]General[/h2]
[list]
[*]Updated a few localizations for Brazilian Portuguese, Russian and Simplified Chinese. These localizations will be fully completed as soon as possible.
[/list]

[h2]Adjustments[/h2]
[h3]ALMOST all Stages in the game[/h3][list]
[*]Most stages have their enemy count reduced, so Stages can be cleared faster in all difficulties;
[*]Amount of Gold and Resources acquired by completing most Stages have been increased to compensate for the reduced enemy amount;
[*]Increased the value of EXP dropped by all enemies to compensate for the reduced enemy amount, to keep the levelling process similar;
[*]Volcano Stages were not changed;
[*]Most EX Stages were not changed;
[*]Challenge Stages were not changed;
[*]Boss Stages were not changed.[/list]

[h2]Bug[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed some typos;
[*]Fixed the tooltip of Well-oiled Machine as it was showing the wrong percentage for activation. This was just a tooltip issue, as the skill was functioning as intended.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - v1.0.1
Crafty Survivors 1.0 Launch
notes.content:
Hello Crafters! 

The time has finally come! Crafty Survivors 1.0 is HERE!

[previewyoutube=W2nGOc5XveE;full][/previewyoutube]

After this long journey of development, the last 2 characters and the last area of the game are added to the game. Wallie, the Builder, and Newston, the Reporter, can be unlocked early in the next area. Both have their own unique mechanics and skills to play.

The Talent Skills for both characters are also available in the Village and will further customize and adjust their gameplay in different ways, opening new possibilities. Remember to check their Talents and choose which ones best fit your play style! 

And if the HEAT was on before, it is now time for the Volcano! The new area has its own materials and field events to fight as well, with its own themed music of course!

Let's dive into the Patch Notes first:

[h2]Patch Notes - v1.0[/h2]

[h2]New Characters[/h2]
[h3]Wallie, the Builder[/h3]
[previewyoutube=lw_spxA9QE0;full][/previewyoutube]
The 1st new character ready to join the Roster! The Builder is here to build incredible Machines for battle!

Wallie uses his hammer to crush enemies in an area in front of him while repairing his Machines that are hit in the process. His Hammer is the only basic attack in the game that has a healing capability in the base kit, which can be acquired at level 2.

Most of Wallie's skills place Machines in the battlefield. The amount of Machines that can be placed in combat is limited, with the limits set by each skill and not by a total number of Machines in general. The stronger the Machine, the less of it can be used. Machines will lose duration over time and can be maintained by his Basic Attack indefinitely, and levelling up his skills will apply the effects of the level to the existing Machines without need to replace them.

Placed a Machine at an undesired place or just want to cause chaos? Special Command, Demolish, will be the Builder's way of repositioning Machines out of cooldown if desired, while causing devastating damage in an area around where the Machines were.

Put your Machines to use and turn the tides of battle with numbers on your side!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42919706/cbb511ba4273b7fa63fcbfdd98585b85289bc65a.gif[/img]

[h3]Newston, the Reporter[/h3]
[previewyoutube=f-iYHTNQvys;full][/previewyoutube]
The 2nd new character ready to join the Roster! The Reporter will use the power of information to vanquish his enemies!

Newston uses his basic attack Camera to deal damage to enemies in a cone in front of him, acquiring a Photo, which is 1 of the requirements of his Special Command, Breaking News.

The Special Command Breaking News requires 3 special Information to be activated: a Photo, a Headline and a Content. The Reporter various skills will provide him with the necessary tools to gather these Information and each of them can have 3 Tiers: Bronze, Silver and Gold. Tier quality of said information will impact the end result of Breaking News to deal more damage or gain extra effects. Lower Tiers of Information will not override higher Tiers.

Mix and matching skills will be the key to getting the best publication for Breaking News!

Newston also has a special skill to "kill himself"! I won't spoil more on this specific skill and let everyone try it out for themselves.

Bring the power of information to the battlefield!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42919706/3b859f0deb9ba3f122ad60ec76fda6fe1e2587f7.gif[/img]

[h2]New Area[/h2]
[h3]Volcano[/h3]
[list]
[*]New enemies to fight;
[*]New field events and hazards;
[*]New bosses and challenges;
[*]New materials;
[*]New music;
[*]Final Boss Battle!
[/list]

[h2]General[/h2]
[list]
[*]All Levels of the Houses added to the Village;
[*]New mail to receive and find;
[*]New achievements;
[*]Added the new characters to the Colosseum;
[*]New Secrets to acquire from the Dealer related to the Volcano.
[/list]

[h2]Adjustments[/h2]
[h3]Characters[/h3]
[list][*][h3]Agriana[/h3]
[list]
[*]Corntlingun - Slightly reduced the base damage of the weapon as it was a lot stronger on bosses than intended;
[*]Corntlingun + Pumpkin Aegis - Slightly increase the base modifier of the weapon combo to compensate the nerf above.
[/list]
[*][h3]Keyra[/h3]
[list]
[*]Grand Key - Reduced the cooldown and damage of the special command.
[/list][/list]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Adjust Keyra's basic attack special key to improve performance;
[*]Small bug fixes.
[/list]

[h2]Steam Community Items[/h2]
We have added all the related Steam Community Items to Crafty Survivors, so players can now have access to them. Trading Cards, Badges and all of it! So for those interested, check them out!

[h2]What's Next?[/h2]
This is the final update of Crafty Survivors! The 1.0! We have finally reached this point of the development after around 2 years and half, and we are very proud of being able to fully release a game with all these quirky ideas we had.

What this means is that there is no new content in store for the future. We will still provide support for Crafty Survivors to fix bugs and make necessary adjustments that we notice for the game, but for content this is all (at least for the foreseeable future). We want to move on to our next projects and work on other genres of game.

After a couple weeks from this release, we will send the content to complete the current Localizations of the game. We want to make sure the content is finalized before we send them for localization and we are able to wrap the ones we have right now. That should take a few months, as we need other people to complete localizations for languages we do not speak and these need to fit everyone's schedule. So we ask everyone for some patience with the process.

And to conclude!
[h2]Thank you everyone![/h2]
We want to thank every person who has been with us through this journey of Early Access! We would never make to this point without you all. So THANK YOU!

We will be moving to our next game, Scaling Up, which we are planning to still release this year! So if you haven't checked it out yet, there is a playable demo right now on Steam (which will receive some reworks later).

notes.title: Character Reveal!
notes.content:
Hello, crafters!

How is everyone? With the Full release of 1.0 coming up and the development of the last 2 characters underway, it is time for ANOTHER REVEAL!

The 2nd character and the last to join the Crafty Survivors roster is ready for his reveal! A character that has been accompanying the game for a very long time, bringing all sorts of information to the group of survivors in the Village.

Meet:
[h2][b]Newston, the Reporter[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42919706/9117d705a85f107dd36582adaba147838eb2ac99.png[/img]

For all that have been checking the in-game mail, this daring Reporter has been constantly sending information back to the other residents as he moved forward is his own adventures, to collect as much information about the plague that assails their lives. Newston has finally completed his job to his satisfaction and decided to join the rest of the gang to use his sources against the pesky Malignants!

The Reporter is a short ranged character, that utilizes his camera to damage enemies and take photos in the process. This Photos are specially important as 1 portion of his Special Command, Breaking News.

Special Command, Breaking News requires 3 different sources of information to become available and the Tier quality of said information will impact the end result of Breaking News to deal more damage or gain extra effects. These information can be gathered by Newston from his Basic Attack Camera or from his different skills, and will be held until the Special Command is activated. Different enemies will provide different Tier qualities of these required information, and higher tiers cannot be overwritten by lower tiers. His base kit allows him to get Bronze, Silver and Gold tiers, with his Talent Tree allowing to got 1 tier beyond them.

Breaking News needs a Photo, a Headline and a Content. Different skills can provide different sources, so mix and matching them will be the key to getting the best publication for the Special Command. His Talent Tree will also allow skills to gather more than 1 source under certain conditions, which will open his kit to more flexibility. 

Newston also has a special skill to "kill himself"! He won't die exactly, but it is a fun skill that we designed for him to be able to throw enemies off his scent!

Turn information into power with Newston!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42919706/3b859f0deb9ba3f122ad60ec76fda6fe1e2587f7.gif[/img]

The Reporter is finally coming! We hope everyone enjoys meeting Newston!

Thank you all again for being a part of this journey with us and playing Crafty Survivors. We are not far from the Full Release and debut of the 1.0 of the game! Newston is the 15th and last character to join the roster for the final game! He has been around for quite a while and some people in the community showed quite a bit of interest in him from the start, so we are really excited to finally get to his announcement! Look forward for his debut in version 1.0!

notes.title: Character Reveal!
notes.content:
Hello, crafters!

How is everyone? With the Full release of 1.0 coming up and the development of the last 2 characters underway, it is time for a REVEAL!

We are revealing him now, as his animations are ready and implementation has already began!

Meet:
[h2][b]Wallie, the Builder[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42919706/dab4334d1d27dc1852a71e8437bb0186f0c7f88c.png[/img]

For those who accompany the letters and news in-game, this man has been mentioned a few times as the one responsible to rebuild all the buildings in the Village. A kind-hearted person who always puts others first in detriment of his own well-being, Wallie has been focused on rebuilding everyone else's houses before repairing his own place, so he has been crashing at the restaurant all along. (close to the food, what a smart man) Now that most buildings are up to a good standard, Wallie decided it is time to join everyone to find out what is happening in the world.

The Builder is a slow melee combatant, that smashes the ground with his hammer, covering a good area to deal high damage. His hammer is also tied to another portion of his mechanic: repairing!

Now, repairing what? Well, repairing what is created from his skills, of course! Wallie's entire kit involves utilizing Turrets for combat, from attacking turrets to defensive ones, that will assist him in the fights ahead. His Turrets however, have a durability timer, so they will break after a certain duration if they are not repaired (which might now be a bad idea depending on strategy).

Wallie can place a limited number of Turrets on the battlefield, with the limits set by each skill and not by a total number of Turrets in general. 

Not happy with the placement of a Turret or just want to cause devastation on its area? Special Command Demolish can instantly destroy a Turret and explode it, causing damage in the area and clearing a Turret from the limits of his skill. 

How about turning the fight into a Tower Defense battle? Walie is your guy for the job!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42919706/cbb511ba4273b7fa63fcbfdd98585b85289bc65a.gif[/img]

Hope everyone is looking forward to meet the Builder!

Thank you all again for being a part of this journey with us and playing Crafty Survivors. We are not far from the Full Release and debut of the 1.0 of the game! We haven't set a date for it yet, but we have an overall idea of when it would be an appropriate time for it. This shall be revealed further into the future as we finalize the content of the game and get it ready for the Full Release. One more character to be revealed later on! So keep an eye on it!

notes.title: Key to Victory! - v0.10.0
notes.content:
Hello Crafters! 

How is everyone doing?

New patch is here, bringing some closure to the HEAT! The Desert area is complete with all its challenges and bosses. 

The 13th character, Keyra, is joining the roster today! A new mechanic exclusive for the Locksmith, as a new ranged attacker, and some of the most ambitious animations I've done so far for the game among her skills. The Patch also brings new challenges and bosses to fight, as it wraps up the Desert.

Keyra also has her Talent Skills in the Village Systems, which can affect her gameplay. So remember to check which ones work for you the most and make the most out of your build for the Locksmith.

This is also the LAST major update before the 1.0 release of Crafty Survivors! There will be no new content and characters added during Early Access, so the next 2 characters will debut TOGETHER with the full release of the game! Maybe a sneak peek of both at the end of this Patch Note? We shall see at the bottom!

Let's dive into the Patch Notes:

[h3]Patch Notes - v0.10.0[/h3]

[h2]New Character[/h2]
[h3]Keyra, the Locksmith[/h3]
[previewyoutube=UIMxF_Ea1g4;full][/previewyoutube]
A new character is ready to join the Roster! The Locksmith is here to unlock her path to everyone's hearts!

Keyra is capable of Locking and Unlocking enemies to deal extra damage to them in a small area. She is a ranged character, that throws small keys in the direction aimed, and these projectiles can interact with her skills and a special debuff on enemies.

Most of Keyra's skills need to be activated by her basic attack Key or her special command Grand Key. Depending on the size of the lock, the key required will be different, so choosing the appropriate attack for the skill is necessary. One of her skills requires both keys to activate! Careful positioning and timed activation may be the KEY to success.

Her Grand Key is specially useful to get out of tricky situations. Keyra throws a big key attached to a chain in the direction aimed, that flies until attaching itself to a big lock. The key will vanish if it misses a lock. If attached to a big lock, the skill can be reactivated to pull Keyra towards the skill and activate it, causing damage to enemies in her path and making Keyra invulnerable while flying towards the lock. A way of keeping herself safe!

She also has a special skill that can lock her health bar! It can be tricky to use, but it can turn the tables in battle completely!

Lock your enemies and unlock the path to your victory with the Locksmith!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42919706/101a05bc7e5042cc7858eb7b624400037d690492.gif[/img]

[h2]Area[/h2]
[h3]Desert[/h3]
[list]
[*]New bosses and challenges;
[*]New materials.
[/list]

[h2]General[/h2]
[list]

[*]New elixirs to unlock new skills;
[*]New achievements.
[/list]

[h3]General[/h3]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]

[*]Added a few failsafes for some achievements that might not be granted when completing certain challenges or bosses;
[*]Fixed a visual bug with Axel's Talent Tree (this had no gameplay impact);
[*]Fixed a bug that would get tutorials stuck if pausing the game when the tutorial appeared;
[*]Other small bug fixes.

[h3]Next Steps[/h3]
This is the debut of the Locksmith and [b]the last major update of the Early Access[/b]! There will be no new characters or areas until the v1.0 and full release of Crafty Survivors.

The work for v1.0 has already began. We have been adjusting things in the game to get it ready for v1.0 and while developing the content for v0.10, I have already began working on the new characters that will join the full release! 2 new characters will be added in the version! notes.title: Money Talks! - v0.9.0
notes.content:
Hello Crafters! 

How is everyone doing?

Crafty Survivors is part of the Game Devs of Color Expo, starting today on Steam! The game will be on discount through the duration of the event! For those who don't know, we are all Latin Americans at Flannel Bear Games (we are Brazilians originally, although we live in Canada now and also, we are 2 people in total, but it sounded more fun to say "we all"), and the music composer that works with us is also Brazilian.

New patch is here, bringing some heated content to the game! Yes, a Desert. That's HOT! 

The 12th character, Monet, is joining the roster today! A whole new gameplay style and some of the weirdest skills we came up with so far are being introduced with the Banker! This patch brings a whole new area with different visuals, music, variants of the pesky enemies and new ones with different mechanics. And of course, some juicy materials to collect, as usual.

Monet also has her Talent Skills in the Village Systems, which can affect her gameplay in some real drastic and dramatic ways. So remember to check which ones work for you the most.

We are also adding a few Quality of Life things in this update, that actually come from a few requests in the community here and on the Discord. We hope some of these changes will help smooth the experience for some players. Check which ones they are at the Patch Notes below.

Also, an important reminder, that we mentioned a few times before:
[b]Crafty Survivors is increasing in price soon to match the final price of the game before the release of 1.0.[/b]

Let's dive into the Patch Notes:

[h3]Patch Notes - v0.9.0[/h3]

[h2]New Character[/h2]
[h3]Monet, the Banker[/h3]
[previewyoutube=JTPU3juYeU4;full][/previewyoutube]
A new character is ready to join the Roster! The Banker is bringing in the Gold and spending it to crush her enemies in battle!

Monet's mechanics all involve the basic resource that has been in the game since the beginning: Gold. While gathering gold through battle, the Banker will be able to use her skills by spending the resource in different amounts. Most of her skills have 3 thresholds of cost that make them even more powerful depending on how much Gold she has available in the battlefield.

Some of her skills play a vital role in acquiring more Gold during the battle, while others focus on spending that Gold to deal devastating damage. There's even a skill that focus on spending Gold to earn MORE GOLD! Are you low on Gold? Monet might be the solution to making more!

The Banker's basic attack also has thresholds of power depending on the current amount of Gold the player has during battle, making it a lot stronger but a bit slower as the fight progresses. 

All of her costs and thresholds scale with the current Stage the player is in, in order to make her viable in every Stage of the game, even the early ones. 

Bring forth the power of Gold to trample your enemies!

[h3]New Levels for the Buildings[/h3]
With the update and a whole new area, new materials have been added to the game, so the buildings in the Village can go even further and bring more power to the Survivors.

As suggested in the community, we were able to add an indicator in the Village that will show if a building can be upgraded or not, so players won't need to click every single building to find out if they can upgrade things.

[*]New variants of enemies, with different behaviours;
[*]New types of enemies;
[*]New materials;
[*]New field events and materials;
[*]New hazards exclusively for the Desert.
[/list]

[h3]Map Completion %[/h3]
As suggested in the community, we added a percentage completion on each Area next to their names. Players will be able to have a rough idea of how much of the Areas they have left to finish them. 
This indication will take in consideration the entire Area, even if the Stages are not available yet in the current version, so in the Desert, players will not be able to reach 100% of the Area for now.

[list]
[*]New mail to receive and find.

After the debut of the building, the Bank, it has been a hint of the possibility of having the Banker in the game, which was definitely a character we started designing after we planned the building. We began her concept with the release of the Bank as a building in the Village and started brainstorming her mechanics during that time, but thought she would be best as a late character than an early one because of one simple detail on her mechanic: using Gold.

Monet is the first AND ONLY character to use Gold as a resource in battle, as the masterful Banker she is. She will bring forth the power of money to fight and dominate the arena! She is a melee character with a varied sized basic attack and all her mechanics involve Gold: the more you have the stronger she can become.

Monet has different types of skills and all of them involve Gold in some way: either spending gold, earning more gold or even spending gold to earn even more. Good planning of her skills can result in massive damage and enormous amounts of gold at the end of the Stage, as some of her passives can boost her gold gain even further. But be careful not to overspend your Gold or the only gold you get at the end will be from the Boss Chest.

The amount of Gold required for her skills is variable depending on the Stage, in order to make her viable in earlier Stages as well. Balancing the requirements around her area would make her impossible to use in earlier areas and overpower her in even later Stages, so every requirement around her skills uses the End of Stage Boss Chest amount as the base for calculations for her skills, which also influences her gains.

Some of her skills even have different thresholds depending on the amount of gold the player has available and can increase the effectiveness and power of said skills even further! Even her basic attack is influenced by the amount of Gold the player has and becomes stronger as thresholds are met, turning this classy lady into a powerful fighter.

Show the enemies the power of money with the Banker and help her and the others protect their hometown!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42919706/6749d30737a6f678d803ae5e39cc11227501e17f.gif[/img]

The new area, the Desert, will also become available with the new character, with new challenges to conquer and new materials to collect. The buildings will have more levels available for them so players can power themselves up even more.

Hope everyone is excited to meet the Banker and put her money to use!

Now, an important announcement regarding Crafty Survivors:
[h3][b]The game will increase in price soon to match the price of the Full Release.[/b][/h3]
With the current amount of content, once again the price of Crafty Survivors doesn't fit anymore on what it should be. As we stated since the beginning of the Early Access and is shown in the Store Page, the game would increase in price after certain milestones were met throughout the development process until we get to the price the game would be on Full Release. We believe it will be a good time to reach that price a short time after the release of the next character, Monet.

[i][b]Why is Crafty Survivors increasing in Price?[/b][/I]
Compared to the Early Access release version 0.1 back in March 2023, the amount of content had a major increase. There were only 4 characters available, 15 Stages in total with 1 boss, none of the current Village Systems.
The last price increase, version 0.5, had 8 playable characters with a total of 154 Skills, 67 Stages in total with 6 bosses, 6 Elixir Skills, and 8 Village Systems that allows players to customize their runs even further, with 108 talents summing up all characters in the Smithing and Weaving Systems.
The next version 0.9, will have 12 playable characters with a total of 231 Skills, 121 Stages with a brand new area, a total of 8 areas (counting the Colosseum), and 20 bosses, 21 Elixir Skills, and a total of 256 talents summing up all characters in the Smithing and Weaving Systems. 

With the final version (1.0) taking the playable character count to 15 with an estimate of around 300 skills in total, 9 areas (with the addition of the last area of the game), more than 150 stages in total and more bosses to fight, possibly more than 30 bosses, an estimate of around 36 Elixir Skills, and an estimate of over 350 talents summing up all characters in the Smithing and Weaving Systems. 
With all this difference in content, Crafty Survivors [b]cannot[/b] be the same price as it currently is.

[i][b]Is this going to be final price of the game?[/b][/I]
Yes! This will be the final price of the game for the Full Release of v1.0 of Crafty Survivors. 

We know that some people might not agree with this change, but we must do what we believe is the best and most fair course of action for the game and the hard work put into its development.

Thank you all again for being a part of this journey with us and playing Crafty Survivors. As the development of the Banker is being completed, I have already began the visual work on the 13th character. Hopefully the development of this new content will continue to go smoothly and it won't be long to finalize the Desert area.

notes.title: A Dazzling Performance! - v0.8.0
notes.content:
Hello Crafters! 

How is everyone doing?

New patch is here, bringing new content to the game! 

The latest character, the Jeweller, is joining the roster today, with a new gameplay style, a completely different set of skills and more challenges. This patch is completing the rest of the Cavern area, with all the missing Stages, new bosses to conquer and a lot more to unlock.

The new row of Talent Skills on the Smithing and Weaving Systems can now be unlocked, bringing a total of 102 new talents to the game! Players will be able to further customize each character and their playstyle. We also increased the amount of Talent Points available with this upgrade, and Agriana is getting an adjustment to her Smithing System, doubling the amount of points she has available in comparison to all other characters (and we are reducing the requirements for her levels to facilitate her upgrades), which should allow players to focus on more than 1 weapon on her system and increase her versatility.

As I mentioned on the previous Daily Newton, we are also making some adjustments to the Difficulty Modes, specially Malignous mode which a lot of players seem to enjoy it but think it takes too long. This is the first change to the mode, reducing the overall Health Buff the enemies get, which will definitely make runs a lot shorter (but will also make the runs easier). So for those who enjoy the mode, let us know if this adjustment made the Malignous Mode better or less fun.

Another important thing about the Malignous Mode. I have noticed some players mentioning on the comments of the Daily Newton post about having to play on the highest difficulty to farm materials as it was necessary to upgrade the Village or it would be too much grind. Before Patch 0.5.3.0, the requirements to upgrade the Village was really high and we have adjusted it following the feedback of the community. I just want to clarify that each area has been adjusted on that Patch to drastically reduce the grind of materials and make it possible to fully upgrade the Village when completing each area (up to the latest area) on Normal Mode with some surplus of material (by completing the area I mean getting the achievement) aside from the 3 boss Material (which was taken into consideration when building the progression of materials - but has been removed on this patch, so read notes below), without taking into consideration the Gathering Systems, possible materials bought from the Merchant and the buff from the Fisherman's Hut. I just want players to be aware that under no circumstances Malignous Mode was taken into consideration for farming materials at any time.

Let's dive into the Patch Notes:

[h3]Patch Notes - v0.8.0[/h3]

[h2]New Character[/h2]
[h3]Jewellia, the Jeweller[/h3]
[previewyoutube=D9JuBW5uvhs;full][/previewyoutube]
A new character is ready to join the Roster! The Jeweller is here to shine and bring light to the battlefield.

Jewellia is a ranged attacker, utilizing her Loupe to fire laser beams that pierce through groups of enemies to deal damage. A great variety of skills can interact with her basic attack to cover wider areas, reflect the attack itself or even cause new effects. She is a character with a good focus on basic attacks.

The Jeweller also brings the power of her Special Command, Opulent Jewel, to aid her in the battlefield. A random Jewel is selected at the beginning of the stage that can be carved utilizing the various skills at Jewellia's disposal, with each skill having different thresholds of carving, until it is broken or perfected. If a Jewel is broken, a new random Jewel will be chosen to restart the process. If a Jewel is perfected, skills won't be able to break it until it is used, by activating the Special Command, which will bring forth the effect of the Jewel and bring a new random Jewel to continue the process. There are 5 different outcomes for this skill! So keep an eye on your Jewels!

Jewellia is also the first character with access to a dual stage dodge. After acquiring a specific passive, players can dodge and leave an illusion of Jewellia at the original spot, being able to return to that position in a short period of time. This dual stage dodge has its own perks and can open up different ways of tackling a challenge!

Jewellia is here, and ready to make the arena sparkle!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42919706/8c8b97f396219a601ed17c6ba68d897bb003a99b.gif[/img]

[h2]Village[/h2]
[h3]New Levels for the Buildings[/h3]
With the update, new materials have been added to the game, so the buildings in the Village can go even further and bring more power to the Survivors.

[h3]Weaving and Smithing System, 102 new Talents[/h3]
With the new materials available, players will be able to further customize each character. A total of 102 new unique Talents have been added to the game, 50 for the Smithing System and 52 for the Weaving System.

[h3]Secret's Dealer and Reword Secrets on Mailbox[/h3]
Players will now be able to unlock the Secret's Dealer, who is going to sell the information of the secrets in-game, related to Secret Exits and Lost Mails in the world of Crafty Survivors. For this, we have reworked the entire Secrets section on the Mailbox, making them more straightforward. We hope this will help players complete the secrets with more ease.

[h2]Exit Signpost[/h2]
All Exits in the Stages received a special asset that will appear when players have unlocked the Stage these Exits lead to. Their function is to show the player if they have either taken the Exit already or tell them that they already found the Stage this exit leads to through another path. We hope this helps players decide on the Exit to take without the need to remember how the Map of the Area looks like.

[h2]Area[/h2]
[h3]Cavern[/h3]
[list]
[*]More Stages to explore, until the end of the Cavern;
[*]New field events to fight for more materials;
[*]New challenges added, with their own bosses.
[/list]

[h2]General[/h2]
[list]
[*]New mail to receive and find;
[*]New Recipes;
[*]New Statues;
[*]New Elixirs.
[/list]

[h2]Adjustments[/h2]
[h3]Smithing System - Agriana, the Farmer[/h3]
[list]
[*]Doubled the amount of Talent Points upgrades that Agriana can have compared to others, since she has a lot more options than other characters. This should allow players to broaden their buffs into more Weapon choices instead of being limited.
[/list]

[h3]Village[/h3]
[list]
[*]Removed the requirement of Boss Materials from a few buildings, so players won't be forced to replay the Boss Stage or to play in Malignous Mode to upgrade the Village. However, the Achievement still requires players to beat the Boss with 3 different characters.
[/list]

[h3]Easy Mode[/h3]
[list]
[*]Reduced the Movement Speed of all enemies by 25% on this Mode;
[*]Increased the amount of materials gained at the end of the Stage to match the same as Normal Mode, so players won't need to farm too much materials on Easy;
[*]Decrease the chance of Aggressive Field Events spawning;
[*]Increase the chance of Healing Field Events spawning by 50%.
[/list]

[h3]Hard Mode[/h3]
[list]
[*]Reduced the Health Buff of enemies from 200% to 150%.
[/list]

[h3]Malignous Mode Mode[/h3]
[list]
[*]Reduced the Health Buff of enemies from 300% to 200%.
[/list]

[h3]Colosseum - All Arenas[/h3]
[list]
[*]Increased the Spawn Speed of enemies after the 1st cycle to the max speed.
[/list]

[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added additional checks in the Village Screen to guarantee that players receive the achievements for unlocking systems;
[*]Characters now become invulnerable as soon as the last boss of a stage is defeated, avoiding situations where some leftover minions or other colliders could kill players;
[*]Small adjustments to skill descriptions and other texts.
[/list]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue with Viala’s Basic Attack, as it was not stacking damage properly when hitting some of her skills;
[*]Fixed an issue with Viala’s Vampiric Solution as it was not healing the player if its conditions were met;
[*]Fixed a bug as Mini Bosses were affected by Fear and Taunt when they should not be, creating weird behaviours like leaving the stage and never returning. Bosses and Mini Bosses are immune to these types of debuffs;
[*]Fixed a bug with Thermal Fissure and Azure Claws as their damage was not being registered to show on the Stats Screen at the end of the stage;
[*]Fixed an issue with the Stage Living Peak as its stage UI was not scaled properly when using 3440x1440 resolutions;
[*]Fixed a bug with Inner Battery Skill as it was dealing 0 damage;
[*]Fixed a bug with the Broccammer as it would not give its last use buff when the number of uses left were 1 before using the double smash attack while equipping the Pumpkin Aegis;
[*]Fixed a bug that allowed Hanvilton to use Heroic Technique in the moment before his weapon breaks, which would cause him to freeze if the weapon was a Claymore;
[*]Fixed an issue as Werewolves were staying active after their duration was over in certain situations;
[*]Adjustments to several Art Assets to reduce the overall size of the game and improve performance;
[*]Small adjustments to Gamepad to improve performance;
[*]Other small bug fixes.
[/list]

[h3]Next Steps[/h3]
This was a huge wall of text, with new content, adjustments, fixes and all the stuff! It has also been one of the longest updates of the game, specially because of the Talents for all the characters, which took surprisingly longer than anticipated. The next batch of Talents will not be released with a new character for sure, as it just makes things take waaaayyyy longer.

So let's dive a bit on the next portion of the content. We are already working on the 12th character and the new area of the game! As previously mentioned on another announcement (Daily Newton #6) we are capping the amount of Stages of the next areas to a certain maximum number, since too many Stages can also be a hindrance. We had to do some pruning on the next area's map, but nothing big.

I thought about doing a sneak peek of the 12th character on this update, but I think it might be good to wait till the next Daily Newton since it would also spoil the next area of the game. I'd rather wait for players to finish the Cavern and see it for themselves before spoiling it. So let's wait a little bit. And keep an eye on it in-game! You might discover the profession of the character in this update! 

We are also working on expanding the Haunted Grounds and bringing more of the area as well. We are planning the challenge and enemies, levels of the Graveyard and the progression of the Halloween area to continue it. So lots of stuff to come!

Now who is ready for some dazzling combat? Time to fight with elegance! We hope everyone has a good time with the update.

notes.title: Daily Newton #6 - Malignous Mode Discussion
notes.content:
Hello Crafters.

How is everyone today? The weather here is nice today, after a lot of rain. So at least there's some Summer going!

As we continue the development of the 11th character, Jewellia, and progress through the Cavern area, we are also thinking about some adjustments in the game that might be good for it.

Besides the development of new content, through new Stages, more Talents for each of the 10 current characters, all the new things added with a new character, bosses and challenges, we have been taking into consideration removing some of the Stages that were planned to the Cavern area to reduce the size of the map and the amount of Stages to do. 

As some of the latest feedback seems that a lot of players think the game is too grindy, it seems that the amount of Stages available per area might be too high, and the designed map of the Cavern had more Stages than the Mountain, we decided to cut back on the Stages. This is not going to impact the current area, as none of the Stages that were already playable will be removed. At least for now. 

Taking this into consideration, we are going to limit the number of Stages in the next areas of the game as well and also adjust the number of Stages in the Haunted Grounds to keep it more on par with previous areas instead of making a massive amount of Stages to fight.

We thought that having more Stages would be more interesting to play, as there would be more things to complete while gathering materials to improve the Village, without having to actually repeat a lot of Stages for it, but it seems that it could have backfired, so we are taking a step back on it and adjusting some of the future content on this. Maybe this will have to affect previous content as well in the future, but we don't know yet. Let us know if you have any feedback on the actual amount of Stages in any of the areas, specially Mountain and Cavern, so we can have a better idea of what our players think.

Moving on from that, we are now going to talk a bit about the Malignous Mode.

We know that it is somewhat a popular difficulty in the game among the community, as a lot of players mention about it. We also take into consideration that the mode can extend the gameplay of some stages in the way the difficulty is applied, and depending on the character chosen, the Stages can take a long time to complete. It seems that this mode, aside from being slightly popular, can also cause some problems, as the lengthy fights can be frustrating for some players.

We have been discussing about this mode for quite a while and some possibilities to adjust it in the upcoming update, but we also want to hear more from the players that enjoy the Malignous Mode on some of the possibilities before we change the difficulty. Any changes to it have to be taken into careful consideration because we know some players enjoy the difficulty as it is, so want to plan it accordingly if any changes are necessary in it or not. This being said, it doesn't mean we are going to change it. We want to hear from the players themselves before we decide on any action.

As it currently stands, it seems that the majority of players that play on this mode seem to want either a bigger challenge or just want to play it because the characters can level up even further than the other modes. So some of the ideas ideas we started thinking about that could adjust the mode are:
1- Reducing the life of enemies in the mode, to reduce the duration of the stage, as enemies will die faster which can reduce the difficulty;
2 - Reduce the amount of enemies, which will reduce the duration of the stage, but also means less experience at the end and less levels.

However, we know some players really enjoy the current mode, so we must take into consideration that:
3 - Mode is fine as is with the amount of enemies and their health pool

We want to hear from whoever enjoys the mode, played on it and etc. As I said, we won't change the mode if a majority of the player base that actively enjoys it wants the difficulty mode in the way it currently is, as we have to take into consideration all sides of the community before committing to a change that can be quite impactful.

So let us know of any of the numbers above what your thoughts are.

I guess that is all for today, with the Daily Newton! More information in the future, so keep an eye out for it.

Have a good day! And keep Crafty!

notes.title: Daily Newton #5 - Summer into the Cavern
notes.content:
Hello Crafters.

How is the weather today?

As the develop of our resident Jeweller continues, we are also working on the progress of the Cavern and the next Stages that will be available in-game, bringing more challenges, new enemies to fight and new materials to collect, so players can progress their buildings even further.

I've seen a lot of players asking around about the Bone material in the forums and sometimes on the Discord, as I imagine they are eager to unlock further levels of the characters Talent Trees, however those are not in the game yet. They will be added with the release of Jewellia and the progress of the Cavern.

As it's always been with the game, the Field Materials are used to halt the content and give us time to continue the development of Crafty Survivors, but they are never hidden in a way that requires searching for them in specific points of a Stage or a special character to find them. As a general rule of these materials, if you haven't found any of them in 2 or 3 stages you played, it means they are not implemented yet. One might question: "Wouldn't it be better to grey out the material for that? Or use another image?", and as simple as that may sound, we should always consider some things related to that. At first, being a simple change, it can also backfire if that material is overlooked later when it's implemented in game as it is only a small detail, it can be forgotten easily. A second point is, when the game is complete, that greyed out material would never exist in the first place, so the experience would be completely different. And of course, very important, there are materials that use a greyscale colour, so that would just be plain confusing in the end. So, that would be why making greyed out versions of the materials would be an issue instead of a good thing.

So just keep that in mind: if the next stages are locked and you haven't found the material yet, it's definitely not in the game.

Considering that though, we are planning to finish the Cavern area with the next update, releasing all the materials and levels available for the buildings of the Village up to the next area. This will bring a lot more Stages, bosses and enemies, along with the sought out Talent Tree of all characters to the game.

However, it will take a bit longer to get to this step, as there is a lot of content to be developed to complete this area, so the next update will take a while. Aside from the bosses (which I won't spoil how many are coming), field events and an entire new character added to the game, the Talent Trees of the characters also takes time, as there are 11 characters to consider, and whenever a new one is added to the game, it just increases the number of skills needed for the game and that adds to the development time.

I mentioned on the Jeweller's reveal that we originally planned only 10 characters and she was supposed to be the last to be added to the roster right? Some might think Mausolea was the one that was not originally planned, but as we mentioned on her reveal and debut, Mausolea was actually in the original plan since the Prototype of the game before the Early Access release! Everything related to her has been planned for a long time before her actual release in-game.
The character that wasn't part of the original 10 was actually Theodore, the Miner. He, along with the other characters that are coming to the game, were designed after the release of the Early Access based on the reception and response to the game, which helped us decide to further the content of the game. 

I guess that is all for today, with the Daily Newton! More information in the future, so keep an eye out for it.

Have a good day! And keep Crafty!

notes.title: Character Reveal!
notes.content:
Hello, crafters!

How is everyone doing this summer? Or this winter, if you live in the south hemisphere?

We want to reveal the next character to join Crafty Survivors this day, 30th of June, to celebrate the end of Pride Month. As a character that has been planned since the prototype of the game, this one is joining exactly at the time planned, before we decided to increase the roster from the initial 10 characters planned. I think I will let you all guess which of the current 10 characters (minus this one of course) was planned AFTER the 10 from our original idea in the prototype (I might reveal this later if you all want). Only one of them. All the next characters were planned later, based on the initial response from players and content creators that engaged with the game.

To start the information of the next character, we would like to introduce everyone to the wife of our dear Seamstress Sewvia. A character that has been mentioned multiple times on letters and news in-game!

Meet:

[h2][b]Jewellia, the Jeweller[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42919706/a03306cf2232f09a42cc142716c5ce86120c55c7.png[/img]
As I mentioned above, Jewellia has been planned since the beginning of the game's concept to join the roster as the last character to unlock. The idea to talk about the relationships between characters in the Village began with her and her wife Sewvia, just as an internal setup for how each character is, their behaviour and personalities, and how they would be, which would help design their sprites, portraits and some of their animations. It was a long time after this that we decided to implement the Mail System to actually tell the lore behind Crafty Survivors.

But enough of that! Let's discuss a bit about her mechanics!

Jewellia is the another character with a ranged basic attack, being able to fight enemies from a safe distance. Her attack pierce through enemies, enabling her to hit multiple targets in a single hit. Some of her skills will interact with her basic attack in unique ways, allowing her to cover bigger areas in a fight. The Jeweller will bring a dazzling performance to the arena with her skills.

Different from all the other characters, Jewellia will also have a special mechanic in her dodge ability. When acquiring an upgrade for her dodge, players will be able to leave an illusory copy of her behind and reactivate the dodge within a timeframe to return to the initial position, giving her more mobility in the battlefield! We are still working on developing this mechanic and its implications in her playstyle, so more information will come later with her release!

Get ready for some Gems and Jewels as the Jeweller reunites with her wife and neighbours to protect their Village and fight the pesky Malignants!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42919706/8c8b97f396219a601ed17c6ba68d897bb003a99b.gif[/img]
And of course, all with elegance.

The Jeweller will share a house with the Seamstress, as it should be, there's no denying that! The Jewellery Shop will be attached to the side of the Tailor Shop and work independently in being upgraded through the Village, but they will be visually the same place. Initially, this shop will only unlock the latest character, as we are still designing what could possibly be a system for it, if there's one we can get for the Jewellery Shop. More information will come in the future, of course, so keep an eye on it.

With the release of Jewellia and her addition to the roster, another material will be made available in the Cavern, the Bone, allowing players to further improve the buildings in the Village. New Challenges in the area as players delve deeper into the tunnels of the Cavern to find the source of the Curse and what is causing all the problems.

Who is looking forward to meet the Jeweller?

Thank you all again for being a part of this journey with us and playing Crafty Survivors.

And we finally got to 500 reviews! Thank you for everyone who left a review to our game and helped us get here. It's a wild journey! Thank you all!!

notes.title: From Beyond! - v0.7.0
notes.content:
Hello Crafters! 

How are you all?

New patch is here, bringing new content to the game! 

It's Halloween!!! Well... actually, it is not... let's just pretend it is, for a moment, ok?
It's Halloween!!

It's finally the debut of the 10th character! Mausolea is bringing a lot of themed charm to Crafty Survivors, together with her multitude of friends from beyond, to fight against the themed horde of Malignants that assail the Haunted Grounds. Join the Gravekeeper in collecting lots of Candy through the areas and bringing havoc to the enemies!

For now, there is no visual changes in town, as it is not actually Halloween and it would delay the release of this content. We decided that making new visuals for the Village for this update would be a hindrance. Maybe in the actual Halloween, time permitting of course, we could add some flavour to the Village. No promises though.

Let's dive into the Patch Notes:

[h2]New Character[/h2]
[h3]Mausolea, the Gravekeeper[/h3]
[previewyoutube=ImhmOGN-MSE;full][/previewyoutube]
A new character is ready to join the Roster! The Gravekeeper and all her friends are ready to rumble!

Mausolea, the Gravekeeper, is the newest addition to Crafty Survivors, bringing the spooky times of Halloween to squash her enemies into nothing!

During battle, Mausolea can collect the souls of her fallen enemies to summon allies of her own. Strength in numbers! She has a variety of companions that can aid her in different ways and turn the tides of battle. From fierce attackers to dauntless supports, they can cover multiple roles!

The Gravekeeper can also lose BODY PARTS during combat as she gets hit! This will affect her stats and also her visuals, such as losing her own head!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42919706/a74116c9a91cc38628d20e3e18ef2c9e26131417.gif[/img]
Lost parts will do their own thing while they are not picked up, which can even increase the number of attacking "allies" in the field, and she can only lose 3 parts in total. Picking those parts up will reattach them to her body, in the order picked! 

[h2]Village[/h2]
[h3]New Building - Graveyard[/h3]
With the update, new materials have been added to the game, so players can finally rebuild the Graveyard and unlock its features!

[h3]Trick or Treating System[/h3]
This System is the new addition to the game as a gathering system that allows players to collect specific materials exclusively for upgrades of the Gravekeeper, the Graveyard and special recipes and designs from the Haunted Grounds. These materials are not needed for anything else outside of these and can be used for selling if the player needs golds!

[h2]New Area[/h2]
[h3]Haunted Grounds[/h3]
[list]
[*]Unlocked a new area, with a different look and more stages to play through;
[*]New enemies added to this area, with their special skills and interactions;
[*]New field events to fight for more materials;
[*]New materials, including;

[*]New song just for the Haunted Grounds.

[h2]General[/h2]

[/list]

[*]Fixed an issue with Chiselo, the Sculptor, when picking up Marble Mastery Lvl 3 without having all the Marble Skills, as it would freeze the game as the passive tried to apply its perks to skills that the player didn't have.

[h3]Next Steps[/h3]
With the debut of the lovable Mausolea (if you don't mind the smell), we are making the finishing touches on the Beach Bosses, which means they are coming out really soon as well!! Can you smell the Summer? Wrapping up the Beach will be the last 4 Stages that have been locked for a while, all with new bosses to fight! YES! All Stages have bosses!

For those who have been accompanying the Daily Newton posts here on Steam, we also mentioned that "J" will be the next character to join the game! The long lost partner of our esteemed Seamstress has been mentioned thoroughly in-game and is the next on in line for development. Different from the other characters we did so far, we won't make a sneak peek of them! You will have to wait for their reveal post!!

The 11th character will bring more Stages in the Cavern so players can continue their progress and maybe get the coveted Skill Points from the Weaving and Smithing Systems, so players can customize each character even further. 

Who is ready for some spooky time? We hope everyone has fun with Mausolea and all her friends! Things are about to get scary and chaotic!!

notes.title: Character Reveal!
notes.content:
Hello, crafters!

Let's start with the information about the upcoming new content.

A new Secret character will join the roster soon:

[h2][b]Mausolea, the Gravekeeper[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42919706/4d8ad327c64c07faae070b050e6906d143d2c4a4.png[/img]

This character has been planned even before the game launched its Prologue version in the end of 2022, so we are REALLY excited to finally get to her debut! She is the 2nd Secret Character to join the roster of Crafty Survivors.
Fun fact: Mausolea, the Gravekeeper, is the character that began the trend of names for all the other characters that were released! It is fun for me anyways, so I thought about sharing. :P

A lot of new things will come with Mausolea to the game, so let us talk a bit about some of it!

The Gravekeeper is introducing a whole new mechanic to the game: collecting souls. When defeating enemies, Mausolea is able to gather a special resource to use her various skills by spending these souls. Most of her abilities involve summoning a variety of spooky friendly companions to aid her in battle against the horde of Malignants. Strength in numbers, as they say.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42919706/5a2519a72c2c0081e6f852eab4b4463caa5a82cc.gif[/img]
Some of them may not look like much, but they each have unique powers that can be key in battle. So don't be afraid to test the various friends that Mausolea made through her MANY years!

The Gravekeeper will also have skills that do not involve summoning or spending souls, allowing her to control her special resource in different ways. Some skills may empower summons or even strengthen Mausolea herself!

Another fun mechanic unique to Mausolea is the loss of BODY PARTS! Yes, that's right. She can lose pieces of her body during battle, which will even alter her visual! Lost parts will do their own thing while they are not picked up, which can even increase the number of attacking "allies" in the field. This however, comes with a downside: losing a body part inflicts a debuff on the Gravekeeper until that specific part is collected.
They usually tell you not to lose your head, but sometimes that can have benefits?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42919706/a74116c9a91cc38628d20e3e18ef2c9e26131417.gif[/img]

With the debut of Mausolea, the 2nd secret area will be unlocked, the Haunted Grounds. Themed around the beloved Halloween, this new area will have its own unique set of enemies to challenge and materials to collect! Said materials are exclusive to the Graveyard building, much like the Beach area was exclusive to the Fisherman's Hut, since it is an entirely optional area for an optional character.

Talking about the Graveyard! Some of you might have noticed that it is already sitting there, in the corner of the Village, doing its thing (a.k.a. nothing). With the release of the Gravekeeper, players will be able to upgrade her "house", unlock her and add a very POWERFUL system in the process: the REVIVE! Yes, you read it right! REVIVE! The Graveyard grant players the ability to revive in battle a set number of times that depends on the level of the building, allowing for even more safety during battle. We all like some safety, right? Right? :P

We hope everyone is looking forward to meet the 2nd Secret Character, Mausolea, and to venture through the spooky area, the Haunted Grounds.

Thank you all again for being a part of this journey with us and playing Crafty Survivors.

And as usual, we want to kindly ask everyone to leave us a review here on Steam when possible, please. The reviews help a lot with the game! So if you have some spare time, please leave as a review when you have a moment. We are almost at 500 reviews for Crafty Survivors, so please, help us achieve this milestone!
Thank you for everyone who already left a review!

notes.title: Endless Replayability Fest! - v0.6.2
notes.content:
Hello Crafters! 

How are you all today?

With the Endless Replayability Fest, a new patch is here! More content is added to Crafty Survivors.

Since this Fest is all about Endless Replayability, why not celebrate it with Endless Stages? We decided to introduce these special Stages in a new area of the game, with some friendly competition. 

The Endless Stages have a Leaderboard to score points and compare with fellow players, with a general section and sections separated by characters, so players can compare points of a specific character if they want. As we are aware of the possibility of people cheating in the Leaderboard, players will also be able to filter the Leaderboard by Friends as well, in order to compare their runs with only their Steam friends, so they can avoid the Global Leaderboard if something seems off, or just to compare with their friends for fun.

Now let's get into Patch Notes:

[h1]Patch Notes - v0.6.2[/h1]

[h2]Leaderboard & New Area - Colosseum[/h2]
This update is introducing a new Secret Special Area, the Colosseum, where players can face off Endless Stages of Malignants and see how far their builds can go. Playing on these stages will score points when the player is defeated, which will be sent to the Leaderboard, where players can join some friendly competition each week. The Leaderboard saves up to 4 weeks and resets every Monday at 12:00 AM EST (the timezone matters in this). Players MUST have an internet connection to have their points saved and added to the Leaderboard. Please, let us know if encountering any issues with these Stages, as this is the first time we are doing something with a point database and we don't have that many people to help us test prior to the release, so bear with us if seeing any issues. We will fix them as we can.

For now, there are 3 Endless Stages and more will come in the future as more content is added to Crafty Survivors and we can build the waves for each of the stages.

[i]How do the Endless Stages work?[/i]
The difficulty of these stages cannot be changed, since they are tied to the Leaderboard and players must compete with the same specific settings to keep things fair, as amount of enemies and speed in clearing the waves will count towards the score. Statues that influence the spawn speed of the enemies and that spawn new enemies (such as the Portrait of Deception) DO NOT WORK on these Endless Stages, since that would affect the setting of how enemies come and unbalance the scores. EVERYTHING ELSE IS GAME!

These stages are brutal! They are a lot more difficult than their regular stages on the areas, so having upgraded the Village will help a lot with going further in the waves. As the game progresses and the Village goes further, players will have more power against these Stages, as their difficulty will not increase from this.

[i]How to unlock the Colosseum?[/i]
SPOILERS for those who DON'T WANT to search for the new area:
[spoiler] Players can access this special area from the Forest Stage 4A with Agriana the Farmer, through a secret exit on the right side of the arena. This will give access to 2 stages to be cleared in order to reach the Secret Area. [/spoiler]
The spoiler above tells EXACTLY where to go and what to do to unlock this area. For players who don't want the exact location and directions, here is a small spoilery tip to find this area:
[spoiler] Around the middle of the Forest area, some Vines were spotted on a cliff around the right side of the arena. [/spoiler]

[h2]General[/h2]
[list]
[*]New Tutorial Panel to explain the difference between the Difficulty Levels. This will appear on the Grasslands Stage 3 upon entering the Character Selection Screen;
[*]New In-screen guide for Viala, the Alchemist, showing the successful combinations of their Special Command Concoct on the right top corner of the screen, making it a quick check for what are the Reagent Combinations. This can be toggled on/off on the Pause Menu;
[*]New Stages in the Cavern;
[*]New Corrupted Adventurer Boss;
[*]New building levels in the Village.
[/list]

[h2]Adjustments[/h2]
[h3]Agriana, the Farmer[/h3]
[list]
[*]Adjusted how the Chilling Mint works: using the Chilling Mint while the effect is still happening will update the effect to the current level of Chilling Mint and extended the duration of the weapon, instead of creating new blizzards.
[/list]
[h3]Enemies[/h3]
[list]
[*]Nerfed the Mountain Boss Maleagle, reducing its maximum health and increasing the cooldown between its attacks;
[*]Nerfed the White Maligbats on the Cavern area, reducing the speed of the purple slash projectiles fired by this enemy.
[/list]
[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*]Adjustments to the Easy Mode: 
[list]
[*]Enemies attack 2 times slower;
[*]Materials and Gold receive a smaller penalty.
[/list][*]Chests can now grant Masterpiece Levels.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed a visual issue with the Village where the Miner’s Shack appears as trees had their sprites cut;
[*]Fixed some visual issues in the Village with duplicate trees.
[/list]

[h1]Next Steps[/h1]
As we already mentioned, the 10th character is coming and they will be a special secret character! They are going to shake things up in the game! Whole different mechanic and more! As we continue developing the 2nd Secret Area and making the Stages of this  special content, we want to bring a good update with this new character, with a good amount of content to play through. Similar to how the Fisherman has been, this new character will be the only one using materials from this new area to upgrade their building, so there's no impact on the overall Village progression if a player doesn't find the Secret Area.

1 - General leaderboard where all characters compete;
2 - Specific character leaderboard, where only that character is shown for comparison.
The leaderboard only shows the Top 5 players during the week. Players can view up to 4 weeks (the current week and 3 previous ones).

Players BEST score is saved per character and per area, regardless if they are on the leaderboard or not. They can also check the competition amongst their friends by changing the view of the leaderboard on the top right, between global and friends.

[h3]Character Presets[/h3]

Players will now be able to select the upgrade they want using the keyboard by pressing 1/2/3/4/5/6/7 (each corresponding to one of the options in order from left to right) and pressing Enter to confirm. The 9th character is joining the roster to shake things up. Theodore is bringing his explosive charm to the Village as its newest resident. With his captivating smile and zero thoughts for consequences, Theodore is a force to be reckoned with on the battlefield.

Together with the newest character, the Cavern is being unlocked, so players can further adventure through the world of Crafty Survivors, finding new challenges to face and new materials to advance the Village. What is in store inside the depths of these tunnels?

Let's dive into the Patch Notes:

[h3]Patch Notes - v0.6.0[/h3]

[h2]New Character[/h2]
[h3]Theodore, the Miner[/h3]
[previewyoutube=_snr6RLinzA;full][/previewyoutube]
A new character is ready to join the Roster! The Miner and his companion are introducing another playstyle to the fights ahead. 

Theodore is accompanied by Carter, his mine cart. By smashing Carter around the area, the Miner is capable of hitting a group of enemies in line, for a good amount of damage.

He doesn't think about the consequences of his actions, which can cause a lot of problems for him. Theodore has a Collapse Bar on the bottom of the screen, which indicates when a collapse of the area is going to happen. The Miner's skills and basic attack fills the Collapse Bar, causing boulders to fall from the ceiling and deal big damage on an area to enemies hit, but they can also harm Theodore!

Talking about actions regardless of the consequences, the Miner has 5 skills that have a massive amount of damage but can harm him if is caught in the blast radius. These skills will require good thinking and positioning in order to keep safe, while clearing waves of enemies with ease. High risk, high reward.

Special Ore spawns around the area when Theodore is in the battlefield, allowing him to mine these as a special resource for some of his skills. Some of these ores can grant the Miner some temporary buffs when close, which can help turn the tides of battle. The miner can also use Carter to mine these ores from a distance and gather their benefits, if the Special Command is level up enough.

[h2]Village[/h2]
[h3]New Levels for the Buildings[/h3]
With the update, new materials have been added to the game, so the buildings in the Village can go even further and bring more power to the Survivors.

Players will always have the option to select Health, Gold or one of the materials from the Stage in any level, as we introduced Masterpiece Levels to all active skills, basic attacks and special commands.

[b]How does Masterpiece Levels work?[/b]
When players have only 3 skills left to reach maximum level (including all active and passive skills), Masterpiece Levels will begin to appear for the current skills the player already has. These new levels will take skills beyond their limit, infinitely improving them as long as the player can level up during a battle.

Each basic attack, active skill and special command has their own unique set of Masterpiece Levels, which can range from increased damage to buffed duration to increased area of effect, among many others. Make sure to test the skills and discover how far you can take them!

[h3]Cavern[/h3]
[list]
[*]Unlocked a new area, with a different look and more stages to play through;

We will bring more information about them in the future here.

notes.title: Grind Adjustment - v0.5.3.0
notes.content:
Hello Crafters! 

After a while and following some feedback regarding the necessity to grind a lot of materials and gold for the Village, we have revised all the levels for each building in the game (except Town Square, Pier and Laboratory) to drastically reduce all of their requirements, cutting the grind to less than 4 times the usual requirement.
Following this, we won't keep the building requirements high before an update and they will be released with their normal number of materials and gold.

Why haven't the Town Square, Pier and Laboratory been affected?
Town Square and Pier require very specific materials that comes from specific chests in each area, which give exactly the amount of gold and materials necessary for their upgrades, so they are not affected by any grinding.
The Laboratory has very few levels available and the Stage necessary to upgrade the building gives a lot more gold than it requires.

The adjustments of the requirements for all the buildings took in consideration that players might not have the best upgrades for Material Drop and Gold Gain from the buildings, to increase the chances of having a surplus of materials and gold when completing all the Stages in each area (complete stages are blue stages, which means that some might need to be done twice and Boss Stages were counted 3 times for the achievement - but secret exits were not taken into account because of the Explorer Mode). Failing a Stage was not taken into account either, so failing a run just means more materials and gold.

All of this adjustment is based on Normal Difficulty, as it is the default challenge of Crafty Survivors. 

This update will drastically reduce the necessity to grind for Village upgrades and should accommodate players with less time available to play.
