notes.title: The Alchemist is here! - v0.5.0
notes.content:
Hello Crafters! 

First we want to start by thanking everyone for their patience waiting for the new character. This latest update has been delayed from our initial schedule due to some unforeseen circumstances.

We have been adjusting the entire game to receive Localizations and a lot of things had to be changed and introduced to accommodate a future update with new languages. As the localizations take a really long time, it has delayed our initial schedule by more than 2 months. We were not planning to work with localizations so early in the game, but since our community has adamantly requested this, we decided to delay development of new content in favour of adding them. 3 localizations will be added in the next patch, after the new character has had some time with the community.

Another thing is that our artist also lost his father these past few weeks, so we have been going through a really hard time, and this also ended up aggravating our development time a little bit. 

So once again, thank you for the wait. The new patch is now available, bringing more content and the latest character of the game.

[h3]Patch Notes - v0.5.0[/h3]

[h2]New Character[/h2]
[h3]Viala, the Alchemist[/h3]
[previewyoutube=29cYCwAmZoY;full][/previewyoutube]
A new character is ready to join the Roster! The Alchemist is bringing a whole new playstyle to the battlefield. 

Viala is a skill machine. The Alchemist is the first character capable of combining 2 skills into a new effect when using them in battle. Throwing 2 skills in the same spot will mix them, causing a variety of effects that can turn the tides of battle in your favour. 5 of their skills can be combined in this manner, so make sure to experiment with the different outcomes to find your favourite.

The Alchemist also has the Concoct Special Command available, which allows different combinations to bring new buffs, attacks and even healing to their skill arsenal. Concoct is a very flexible skill, but requires specific combinations to pull off correctly and is the first Special Command that can FAIL. Combinations can be reviewed on the Concoct tooltip when pausing the game at any time.

Viala also has a skill directly related to losing health and getting hurt. Receiving damage can boost the Alchemist's damage and take their power to a whole new level, sometimes even in a permanent way. A high risk high reward maneuver that can make things interestingly dangerous.

[h2]Village[/h2]
[h3]New Levels for the Buildings[/h3]
With the update, a new material has been added to the game, so the buildings in the Village can go even further and bring more power to the Survivors and a whole new System.

[h3]Elixir System[/h3]
After unlocking the new character, Viala, players will have access to their Laboratory and a new System will become available. Using the Alchemist's expertise, players will be able to use some materials to create special Elixirs that can be equipped and unlock New General Skills for all characters! These are special skills related to the materials collected and will be the same for all characters, allowing players to expand their builds and experiment with other combinations.

[h3]Building Level Compendium[/h3]
Each building has a new button on their information panel that allows players to verify all the currently available levels for the buildings. This will allow everyone to check what are the upgrades it receives on each level.

[h2]New Stages[/h2]
[h3]Mountain[/h3]
[list]
[*]New stages added;
[*]New field event to fight for more materials;
[*]New challenge added;
[*]New adventurer to face in battle.
[/list]

[h2]General[/h2]
[list]
[*]New recipes;
[*]New sculpture design;
[*]New mail to receive and find;
[*]New Graphic Settings - Added FPS lock settings;
[*]Added an arrow to indicate where certain things are in the Stage, such as a boss, chests and even Hatchet.
[/list]

[h2]Character Changes[/h2]
[h3]Stoverick, the Chef[/h3]
Chef's Resilience nerf:
[list]
[*]Block chance maximum reduced from Lv 1 - 20%, Lv 2 - 30%, Lv 3 - 40% to Lv 1 - 20%, Lv 2 - 25%, Lv 3 - 30%;
[*]Block chance threshold increased from 10 Bistro Stacks to 20 Bistro Stacks.
[/list]

[h3]Axel, the Lumberjack[/h3]
Charging Mechanic buff:
[list]
[*]Increased the % of damage done by charging his basic attack and skills. 1st charge deals 250% damage and 2nd charge deals 500%.
[/list]
Skills Buff:
[list]
[*]Increased the base damage of Chopping Whirlwind;
[*]Slightly increased the damage of Stumping Smash;
[*]Increased the damage of Natures Power.
[/list]

[h3]Sewvia, the Seamstress[/h3]
Basic attack Yarn Ball nerf:
[list]
[*]Yarn Ball Lvl 6 - Yarn ball bounces now have a cap to their maximum damage regardless of how many bounces it can do up to 100% extra damage.
[/list]

[h2]Adjustments[/h2]
[h3]Enemies[/h3]
[list]
[*]Greatly Increased the health of the Corrupted Warrior. He is not supposed to die this fast;
[*]Adjusted the SFX of the Pink Maligbats in the mountains, so they become less annoying when shouting;
[*]Aggressive Field Events take slightly longer to initially spawn on more difficult levels.
[/list]

[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*]Changed the font of the entire game. This change was necessary to adapt the game for the incoming localizations as to properly fit the difference between multiple languages. This also required us to review all of the game's content to adjust text boxes and tooltips to make sure the texts were displaying appropriately. 
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue that increased the cooldown time of the Dodge during certain runs;
[*]Fixed a bug with Hanvilton’s passive skills as they were recovering durability of legendary weapons;
[*]Other bug fixes.
[/list]

[h3]Next Steps[/h3]
Due to the delays on the development because of the circumstances mentioned on the beginning of this update note, some of our plans were delayed. We had a special Halloween character that was planned for October 31st, which we were not able to add to the game. This special character will still be added to the game at a later update, but it won't be on the next Halloween, as it would be too far from our initial plans. We still want to bring this character to the game regardless of any events.

As we also mentioned, localizations are in the works right now. We already have a good amount of content ready to be added to the game for 3 languages, but there is still some content missing for it, so we are going to be working on these for the next update of the game. We also want to give some time for the community to test Viala before we commit her content to any localizations, so it should take some time before we add this update.

After these Localizations are added we will develop the Boss of the Mountain area and some new challenges of the game before we begin the 9th character. We already know the order of all the characters and we are now designing the crazy shenanigans of the 9th one. We will reveal more later!

We are still adjusting the game's assets to reduce the overall file sizes of the game and possibly improve performance in the future, specially on lower-end hardwares. 

We hope everyone is excited to meet Viala and see the power of the Alchemist conquering the battlefield!

Also, don't forget to leave us a review here on Steam when you can, please. The reviews help a lot with the game! So if you have some spare time, please leave as a review when you have a moment. Our goal is to reach 500 reviews now, which is still a long way! So we need all the help everyone can give us.

notes.title: Character Reveal! & Announcements
notes.content:
Hello, crafters!

Let's start with the information about the upcoming new content.

A new character will join the roster soon:

[h2][b]Viala, the Alchemist[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42919706/4c30e968004e94a50c450c214065019b91d8756d.png[/img]

Progressing through the new Stages of the Mountain, players will find a special challenge where they can meet the new character, unlocking them and their building as well.

Viala is the first character capable of combining 2 skills into a whole new one. 5 of her skills have special interactions between each other. Throwing one of these skills on top of another will morph them, either combining the effect of both or even bringing a whole new effect to the battlefield! Experiment with skills and combinations to bring forth Viala's devastating power to the combat!

Using skills gives players a special resource that can activate Viala's Special Command: Concoct! Through a combination of up to 3 of these resources, Concoct will cause a variety of effects that can range from devastating damage to healing Viala's wounds. However, wrong combinations can result in a Fail. Do not worry though! Failing the special command will not harm the player, it will just result in minimal damage to enemies.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42919706/aab614ddfe19137f9543b4695ffce4de17ce3b5d.gif[/img]

Accompanying Viala in the update, new Stages of the Mountain and challenges will be introduced in the game, along with the last Field Material of this area, and a brand new System with the Laboratory! This System will add more options for players in the battlefield!

We hope everyone is excited to meet Viala and the new System in the next big update.


Now on to the next important announcements:

[h2]Crafty Survivors is increasing in price SOON![/h2]
With the current amount of content, we believe that the price point of Crafty Survivors doesn't fit anymore. As we stated since the beginning of the Early Access and is shown in the Store Page, the game would increase in price after certain milestones were met throughout the development process and we got to this point already. 

This is the lowest price Crafty Survivors will be in a very long time, so if you are still on the fence about buying the game, this is the cheapest it will be until we reach a point of a major discount (far into the future).

[b]Why is Crafty Survivors increasing in Price?[/b]
Compared to the Early Access release version 0.1 back in March, the amount of content had a major increase. There were only 4 characters available, 15 Stages in total with 1 boss, none of the current Village Systems.
The latest version, 0.4.1.4, has 7 playable characters, 59 Stages in total with 4 bosses, 8 Village Systems that allows players to customize their runs even further. 
The next version 0.5 will add the 8th character, more Stages to the mountain with more bosses and another new System to the Village. 
With all this difference in content, Crafty Survivors cannot be the same price as it currently is.

[b]Is this going to be final price of the game?[/b]
No, it is not. There are 8 more characters to a total of 16, much more Stages and bosses, and even Systems to be developed and added to the game. We don't know yet when we will reach the next milestone for a price change in Crafty Survivors.
We will make an announcement much like this one when the time comes.

We know that some people might not agree with this change, but we must do what we believe is the best and most fair course of action for the game.


More on the announcements of the future of Crafty Survivors:

[h2]Localizations[/h2]
We finished setting up the game's system and content, so we are ready to start any Localization process for the game. We already began working with a few languages and those should be released after Viala's update. We are interested in adding more localizations in the future, so we ask everyone's patience since this will depend on our budget. This is not an easy process and as a game that is still in Early Access, things can easily change so we are taking it one step at a time.

Let us know if there is any specific localization you are looking forward to!


Thank you all again for being a part of this journey with us and playing Crafty Survivors.

And as usual, we want to kindly ask everyone to leave us a review here on Steam when possible, please. The reviews help a lot with the game! So if you have some spare time, please leave as a review when you have a moment. The reviews are slowly growing up! 500 reviews is the next big step for Crafty Survivors, so please, help us achieve this milestone!
Thank you for everyone who already left a review!

notes.title: Backup & Bug Fixes - v0.4.1.4
notes.content:
[h1]Patch Notes - v0.4.1.4[/h1]

[h2]Backup Save File System[/h2]
We implemented a new backup save file system to avoid loss of progress. Every 15 minutes the game will create a backup save file in the same folder as your normal save file. Upon starting the game and reaching the screen where you can select the areas to go, the game will check if your save was gone or reset and will restore it by making it the same as your backup.
We also changed when the game first tries to access your save to better ensure the steam integration is working properly before.

[b]Backups will only be created with this update![/b] The game doesn't have a backup of any save files prior to this and the first backup will only be created after 15 minutes of playing the game in version 0.4.1.4.

[b][i]For players that choose to delete their save files on the settings screen, the backup will also be deleted.[/i][/b]

We hope this new addition mitigates any loss of progress by players.

[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*]Players using keyboard and mouse can now click on the notifications at the bottom of the screen to close them faster. 
[/list]

[h2]Adjustments[/h2]
[h3]Stoverick, the Chef[/h3]
[list]
[*]Stoverick can now accumulate up to 2 Bistro Stacks per enemy when applying the 5 different status available to his arsenal of skills.
So now making an enemy chopped, spiced, roasted, candied and frosted will give two bistro stacks instead of one.
[/list]

[h3]Hanvilton, the Blacksmith[/h3]

[/list]

[h3]General[/h3]

[*]Changed the quantity buttons of the Financing System and added a Max Invest button to change the value to the maximum amount possible.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added a check to give the Breaded Tilapia recipe to players that used the latest restoration branch;
[*]Fixed an issue with Corntling Gun's Skill Tree not displaying properly as some images were missing reference;
[*]Fixed an issue with Sewing Journey not dealing damage to enemies;
[*]Fixed some texts;
[*]Fixed an issue when performing a Dual Axes Stress Test Skill while the Water Augment was active Hanvilton, creating way more food effects than intended;
[*]Fixed an issue with the movement speed buff not being applied properly for enemies that are already very fast. We implemented a cap to avoid unfair enemies but it made enemies slower instead. That is fixed now and they just wont receive the buff.
[/list]


[h1]Next Steps:[/h1]
Now that we were able to adjust the game to have its own backup method, we hope this can help with any issues related to loss of progress. We were not able to replicate any loss of progress on our saves on different computers and the Steam Deck, so we were not able to figure out what could be the cause of the issue that plagued a few players so far. We know it is really frustrating and we hope this new update will help with this from now on.

We can now properly resume the development of the 8th character to join the roster of Crafty Survivors. Most of their animations and skills are already complete, and we will soon begin to implement them in the game. Here is another sneak peek on the character:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42919706/345cbee4c746a226aafc0d91a9832d1bc83091df.gif[/img]

We will also continue to adapt the game's structure to receive localizations in the near future. We already began to localize portion of the content in our native language and we will soon search for partners for other languages. So keep an eye out for it! We will add localizations as we are able to find appropriate partners for each language, so we ask for your patience while we are making these next steps.

As we mentioned before, we think it is good to remind everyone that [b]the newest content of the game won't be released with their localization[/b]. As the game is in Early Access and there's always chance to balance new content after its release, we will wait some time before localizing any new content.

Thank you again everyone for all your patience and for playing Crafty Survivors! We hope everyone is having as much fun playing the game as we have developing and testing it.

notes.content:
Hello crafters! 

Thank you for the wait. The new patch is bringing 2 new systems that will further customize the gameplay of all characters. Players will be able to focus on specific characters through these systems, focusing on their favourite ones first! It also brings a brand new type of enemy!

To celebrate this patch and the participation in 2 events, Crafty Survivors will be on sale as well!

Let's get to the information of this patch.

[h3]Patch Notes - v0.4.1.0[/h3]

[h2]Village[/h2]
[h3]New Levels for the Buildings[/h3]
With the update, a new material has been added to the game, so the buildings in the Village can go a bit further and bring more power to the Survivors, along with 2 brand new systems.

[h3]Smithing and Weaving Systems[/h3]
Upgrading the Forge and the Tailor Shop will unlock 2 new systems at the Village that will allow players to further customize the characters and their playstyle. 

At the Forge, the Smithing System allows Hanvilton to upgrade weapons, improving the offensive capabilities of each character.

At the Tailor Shop, the Weaving System allows Sewvia to upgrade the clothing of all characters, improving their defensive capabilities.

Both systems function in a similar way: players will upgrade each character individually, unlocking levels of the character's weapon or clothing and a skill tree, where players can allocate points on the desired node. Skill tree nodes will add new passive effects to the character, improving defence and offence.

Players will be able to refund spent points anytime they desire without any extra material or gold costs. Test out different combinations and find out new builds that work best for your gameplay!

New skill nodes will be added on future updates as the game progresses and new materials are added.

This update is introducing 86 new passives skills in total, so players can customize characters the way they prefer!

[h3]Mountain[/h3]
[list]
[*]New Stages added;
[*]New field event to fight for more materials;
[*]New type of enemy.

The first Corrupted Adventurer to fight is the Warrior!

Corrupted Adventurers will bring a new type of challenge to the game. They have a set of skills at their disposal and they start with a random combination of them every time they join the battlefield. They are able to collect experience on the ground to gain levels and improve themselves, learning new skills or improving existing ones. They are also vicious fighters that will hit anything in their way, damaging even other monsters, so use this to your advantage!

What will their profession and mechanic be? Later we will reveal more about them! So keep an eye for it.

"Recovery" for Save Files
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We just added a branch on Steam to assist those who lost their progress in the game regardless of the reason. This is a special branch with a single screen giving specific options to players so they can choose the appropriate base progress closest to where they were before as possible.

[b]THIS ACTION IS PERMANENT![/b] Using this branch and clicking on the options will alter your Save [b]FOREVER[/b]. So we recommend using this branch [b]ONLY if you lost your save[/b].

Review any information about how the save files work and where they are saved in your local files on this announcement here: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/2137760/announcements/detail/3640650512248142498]Regarding Lost Save Files[/url]

Important information about the saves are referred there. Remember that launching the game without Steam won't backup your save files properly and using any third-party plug-ins/software to alter any of the game's information can cause issues to the game and end up corrupting your save files and erasing your progress. [i][b]Use them at your own risk.[/b][/i]

[h2]Changing to the new branch[/h2]
If you have lost your save file, you can change to this new branch to alter your current empty save to recover some of the progress.

1 - Click on the Manage Button on the game's page, represented by a Cog. Select the Properties option.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42919706/066a596217780dbc4efcf0901203fef710d20749.png[/img]

2 - Click on the Betas menu on the left side of the new window.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42919706/edd7ecc603a54e5f76163f98be61d4f3a77f58ed.png[/img]

3 - Type the code SaveUsPlease in the Private Betas section. Make sure it is written properly. The field is case-sensitive.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42919706/f8823115f2e9ffdf77d075efcffadbc625df5993.png[/img]

4 - Click on the blue button that appears to opt-in the new Salvation Branch and automatically start adjusting to the new branch. Steam will start downloading new files to adjust the version.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42919706/7ab6b11bf307229cf34734dbe09b6a5bac107462.png[/img]

5 - Make sure the Branch is being properly shown on the left side menu of your Library. It must say [Salvation] next to the game's name.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42919706/444c8cb5baee13d2e85f18ff7a4c065dee7211fa.png[/img]

6 - Launch the game on Steam using the Green Play Button.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42919706/f5ba6ac1d4059e86ae6e353c4d17daa40cc36406.png[/img]

[h2]Altering the Save File[/h2]
After launching the game a different screen will appear. This screen will give the main information regarding the alteration of the save files through this Branch.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42919706/02ccf7ee424700dd741b2d3111efab7b89cd0ea5.png[/img]

1 - Select the appropriate option considering how close they are to your lost progress. Each option has a description of what threshold of the game it takes the player to.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42919706/7133daee7dd860eeb4b9fa865eee074177c319ea.png[/img]

2 - A pop-up to confirm your action will appear. Click Yes if you want this option or No if you want to choose a new one. [b]Remember that this action is PERMANENT! There is no turning back from this option.[/b] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42919706/9d0f2367996256704b28b08eee87f053abce9221.png[/img]

3 - Click on the Red X button at the top right corner to close the application properly.

[h2]Return to the Default Branch[/h2]
When the game closes after clicking the Red X button, MAKE SURE to return to the default branch in order to play the game. The Salvation Branch doesn't have the game, so it will never run from it.

1 - Click on the Manage Button on the game's page, represented by a Cog. Select the Properties option.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42919706/066a596217780dbc4efcf0901203fef710d20749.png[/img]

2 - Click on the Betas menu on the left side of the new window.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42919706/edd7ecc603a54e5f76163f98be61d4f3a77f58ed.png[/img]

3 - Click on the drop-down menu on the right side of the window and select None. This is the Default Branch of the game. Clicking on the option None will adjust the game back to its main branch, redownloading the proper information.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42919706/05e5af1eb101dc6e8b83f880bfe6510cd2ddfdb6.png[/img]

4 - Make sure that the game's name has no information extra on the menu of your Library. The [Salvation] should not be showing anymore.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42919706/9a8b11afea77f86a102adf77b229bc40cd86804c.png[/img]

[h2]Important Information on this Process[/h2]
Using this branch to restore some of the progress will mostly bring back things like unlocked characters, cleared stages, materials being sold by the merchants, mails, secret stages, chests, recipes and statues.

Some particular things won't be recovered, as there is no way to get back this information on the saves:
[list]
[*]Characters that cleared specific stages in specific difficulty modes;
[*]Amount of materials. All materials will be reset to 1, in order to assure that players have access to the materials of the area they finished at so they can be sold by the merchants;
[*]Amount of gold;
[*]Foods, statues and any information regarding the Systems, such as what was at the Farm or Fisherman's Hut.
[/list]

notes.title: Regarding Lost Save Files *Update*
notes.content:
*Edit* After posting this notice, we had an idea to possibly help with lost saves.
We are going to work on adding a branch on the game that will allow players to recover some of their lost progress. We are still discussing how it's going to work and the specifics of it. Since we can't know the specifics of each save file to get back the exact progress of the game, we are planning on a way that a player can temporarily change the game's branch and alter the game's progress to certain predetermined thresholds. We know this is not the perfect solution, but this at least gives an option for players to recover some of their lost progress without starting from the beginning.
After we implement this, we will create a notice with all the steps to adjust the save files for the players that lost it.

Hello everyone,

We are really sad to hear that some players reported losing their save files and wanted to make some points clear as well as provide some instructions that may help with this situation.

The saving system of our game only save files locally on your computer. We do not own a server or database that hold this info, therefore we don't have access to any save files nor any version of them at any given time. This means that, unfortunately, we cannot help you recover your lost progress. What we can do is help you understand how this process works and where the files are located.

What players can do to make sure they can save their files in the cloud and use them on other computers is through Steam Cloud Save. The way we had to setup the saving process for Steam Cloud Save ties your save file to your Steam Account ID and it uses this info when you start the game to find the data, which means you have to open the game through steam to make sure everything will work.

We realized that most of the players that reported this issue to us lost their progress close to an update or when we push quick patches to solve some issues. We know that Steam Cloud does not synchronize properly when the version the player currently has doesn't match the latest version so make sure to update your game to the latest version before launching the game again and make sure Steam Cloud is properly synchronized. In our experience, we found out that restarting Steam forces it to update games.

With that said, we want to show you where you can find the files in your computer in case you want to create a manual backup or check them.

You can find the saves on your computer at: 

For windows users:  
LocalDisk/Users/(yourcomputeruser)/AppData/LocalLow/FlannelBearGames/CraftySurvivors 

For Mac users:
~/Library/Application Support/FlannelBearGames/CraftySurvivors

Here you will be able to find a folder that is named after your Steam ID, usually represented by a series of numbers. Inside this folder you will be able to see your save file named as saveState.dat and the saved settings as settingsSaveState.dat. 

[b]IMPORTANT: If there is a "saveState.dat" file that is located OUTSIDE this folder, it is a different saved progress that is used when you launch the game without Steam being opened. This save is not linked to any account and is not saved on Steam Cloud. That is why it is important to always launch the game through steam, so you can make progress on the proper save file. [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42919706/c84a92cce8dff8de041c51f6f5a7ba624becd5da.png[/img]

Here are also a link that may help you understand/solve your situation:
https://help.steampowered.com/en/faqs/view/68D2-35AB-09A9-7678


We hope this sheds some light on the situation and helps those who were affected.

notes.content:
Hey everyone! 

Thank you for the wait. The new patch is now available, bringing more content and the latest character of the game.
Hanvilton is also bringing a discount with his release!

[h3]Patch Notes - v0.4.0[/h3]

[h2]New Character[/h2]
[h3]Hanvilton, the Blacksmith[/h3]
A new character is armed to join the Roster! The Blacksmith is bringing a new playstyle to the battlefield. 

Hanvilton doesn't have a Basic Attack at the start of the fight. He uses his Special Command to forge 1 of 3 available weapons and gain a Basic Attack based on the weapon of choice: a claymore, a spear or dual axes. Forged weapons have a set durability that is consumed by attacking or using certain skills, and they will break when there's no durability left. To keep the same weapon, Hanvilton can Repair it using his Special Command as well.

His animations and attacks will change according to the weapon chosen, which can influence the course of the battle. Are you going for slow massive damage? Or high precision? Or maybe, fast attacks? Or swap between them as the weapons break? Some of his skills will be different depending on the weapon. So test between them and see what the Blacksmith can bring to the battlefield!

[h2]Village[/h2]
[h3]New Levels for the Buildings[/h3]
With the update, new materials have been added to the game, so the buildings in the Village can go even further and bring more power to the Survivors and a new System.

[h3]Farming System[/h3]
Upgrading the Farm will unlock a new System to the Village. Agriana and her sisters can cultivate a variety of produces in their Farm to collect already known materials and brand new ones only available through Farming. These materials can be used to cook new foods and upgrade the Farm itself. Most of the upgrades related to this building will come from the Farming System.

[h2]New Area[/h2]
[h3]Mountain[/h3]
[list]
[*]Unlocked a new area, with a different look and more stages to play through;
[*]New enemies and variations added to this area, with their special skills and interactions;
[*]New field events to fight for more materials;
[*]New materials, including fishes;
[*]A new song just for the Mountain.
[/list]

[h2]General[/h2]
[list]
[*]New recipes;
[*]New sculpture designs;
[*]New mail to receive and find.
[/list]

[h2]Character Changes[/h2]
[h3]Stoverick, the Chef[/h3]
Overcooked buff:
[list]
[*]Increased the damage of the Burn Debuff inflicted to enemies.
[/list]

[h3]Axel, the Lumberjack[/h3]
Basic Attack buff:
[list]
[*]Increased his Basic Attack damage.
[/list]

[h2]Adjustments[/h2]
[h2]General[/h2]
[list]
[*]Reworking some of the graphical assets packaging to reduce the overall file size of the game and possibly improve some performance.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Agriana’s Watering Can lvl 6 buff now work correctly on Pumpkin Aegis' crop;
[*]Fixed the level up information of Skill's damage number being zero on levels 2 and higher;
[*]Other bug fixes.
[/list]

[h3]Next Steps[/h3]
We decided to delay the Weaving System to the next update as we are redesigning our initial idea for that System to bring something more interesting and fresh to Crafty Survivors. This System will come on the next update with more stages for the Mountain.

We already have the next character planned as well, all their skills and mechanics. We are starting the development of the 8th character soon. (We already have their base sprite designed!)

We are still adjusting the game's assets to reduce the overall file sizes of the game and possibly improve performance in the future, specially on lower-end hardwares. As we mentioned previously, this process is very slow and we have to balance it between the development of the new content. We have already began with several assets of the game and there are still a lot to be done. 

We hope everyone is excited to meet Hanvilton and take him to battle! 

Also, don't forget to leave us a review here on Steam when you can, please. The reviews help a lot with the game! So if you have some spare time, please leave as a review when you have a moment.

notes.content:
[h1]Patch Notes - v0.3.1.0[/h1]

[h2]New Features[/h2]
[h3]Difficulty Modes[/h3]
Added Explorer and Malignous Modes to all Stages:
[list]
[*]Explorer mode can be accessed once a stage is already completed. When entering a stage on Explorer mode there won’t be any enemies and the stage exits will be opened. You will be free to explore and look for secret exits and collectables. Perfect for players that have less time to play or have trouble using a specific character to open secret paths. [b]You won’t collect any materials, won’t change the current stage buffs, won’t give you a chance of village events happening and the village systems won’t collect materials.[/b]
[*]Malignous mode is an even more challenging and punishing mode than the Hard mode. There are 2.5x more monsters and they have 3x more health, however there is an experience penalty as well. Enemies drop 3x more gold, stage chests give you 2x more gold, you earn 2x more materials for winning the stage and the material drop chance is 2x bigger. Malignous mode will make stages lengthier and overwhelming, as it will take longer to clear the first wave of enemies, so don't take it lightly.
[/list]
Added a new symbol on the Character Select Screen to indicate what mode was complete with each character per stage. The game will show the most difficult mode only, so if a player completes a Stage in Hard mode, it will override Easy and Normal Jewels for example.
[list]
[*]Bronze Jewel - Easy
[*]Silver Jewel - Normal
[*]Gold Jewel - Hard
[*]Purple Jewel - Malignous
[/list]
[b]IMPORTANT[/b]As we were not tracking which character was doing each Stage, this information was not saved previously. So to get the respective Jewels on all Stages, players will have to re-do stages with the characters on different modes to save these Jewels.

[*]Newspaper will tell more about what is going on in the game’s world;
[*]Letters will let players know more about the Character’s personality and relationships;
[*]Hints will give you tips on how to find secrets in the game.
[/list]
[b]IMPORTANT[/b]Enter all unlocked areas to ensure you will receive mail from stages you already completed before the update, as some mail is delivered for completing certain stages. You just need to enter the area and not the stages themselves.

[h3]Help Section[/h3]

[/list]

[h3]Stage Pause Menu[/h3]
When selecting Retry or Exit Stage on the Pause Menu, players will be asked if they are sure about their decision.

notes.title: The Fisherman is sailing in! - v0.3.0
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 

Thank you for the wait. The new patch is available, bringing more content and the latest character of the game.
Rodrigo is also bringing a discount with his release! 

[h3]Patch Notes - v0.3.0[/h3]

[h2]New Character[/h2]
[h3]Rodrigo, the Fisherman[/h3]
A new character is sailing into the roster! The Fisherman is bringing a new mechanic and a lot of new visuals with him. 

Rodrigo's attacks and skills have a variety of possible outcomes that depend on luck: Bad, Good, Great and Perfect. Bad outcomes usually result on low damage, Good ones represent the standard behaviour of the skill and Great and Perfect add effects that make skills more powerful.     

His basic attack and special command are connected and level up at the same time. [b]Both use his fishing rod to catch fish, so they cannot be used at the same time.[/b] While Lucky Catch has random outcomes, Patient Fishing will have better results based on the time waited before activating again.

When using his basic attack and skills, Rodrigo will catch fish. These will be turned into materials at the end of the stage, based on the area where Rodrigo fights.

Rodrigo is the first Secret Character to be introduced in the game.

What is the difference of a Secret Character?
Secret Characters won't be unlocked by following the main areas of the game and will require their own area's materials to upgrade their houses for most of their levels.

[h2]Village[/h2]
[h3]New Addition[/h3]
Fisherman's Hut is now available to repair and upgrade, unlocking the new character and further improving stats.

The Pier is also a new building that will bring its own merchants to the village, with different materials and goods to buy.

[h3]Fishing System[/h3]
Upgrading the Fisherman's Hut will unlock a new system that will help players gather Rodrigo's unique materials as they play the game. Further levels will bring more areas and materials for the players, so they can unlock more upgrades with ease.

[h2]New Area[/h2]
[h3]Beach[/h3]
[list]
[*]Unlocked a new area, with a different look and more stages to play through;
[*]New enemies added to this area, with different interactions and visuals;
[*]New materials to improve the Fisherman's Hut and the Pier;
[*]A new song just for the Beach.
[/list]

[h2]General[/h2]
[list]
[*]New recipes;
[*]New sculpture designs;
[*]Added Item tooltips on merchant menus.
[/list]

[h2]Character Changes[/h2]
[h3]Stoverick, the Chef[/h3]
Special Command Serve! rework:
Due to hard mode we were able to notice that the way the Serve! skills works was detrimental to the game's progress. It got too easy to accumulate 20 stacks when enemies have a higher health which showed us that as the game progresses it would become trivial to just use Serve! multiple times and defeat all enemies. To adjust this behaviour we are changing how the Serve! skill works.
[list]
[*]Before - Serve! had a base damage of 300, granted buffs of 20% and needed 20 stacks to be used, capping the bistro stacks at 20.
[*]After - Serve! base damage reduced to 100 and buffs reduced to 10%. Players can now accumulate infinite stacks. For every 20 stacks the damage of the skill increases by 100% of its base damage and the buffs increase by 5%, until a cap of 30%.
[/list]
This way players will still be able to one-shot enemies at the initial areas of the game but will need to accumulate more stacks if they wish to defeat stronger ones. Reducing the Serve! skill spam and creating a deeper mechanic for players to use.

[h3]Sewvia, the Seamstress[/h3]
Style and Substance (dash ability) rework:
[list]
[*]Before - Dash charges only entered cooldown after using all charges, but all charges would be granted back after its cooldown.
[*]After - Dash will now enter cooldown as soon as a charge is used, but cooldowns will only grant one charge back after its time. Dash cooldown has been slightly reduced to accommodate the new cooldown system, however it will take longer to get all charges back for Style and Substance. Using a charge will reset the cooldown back.
[/list]
Sewvia’s survivability was way too strong by having the multiple charges of her dodge easily available to her. This way she can still do a lot of damage and create multiple ground needles but it will need more preparation time, making her playstyle slightly more challenging but still safer than all other characters.

[h3]Chiselo, the Sculptor[/h3]
Nature's Embrace nerf:
[list]
[*]Decreased the healing chance of the skill.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug with Hatchet who stopped working properly when using the skill Beaver Bubbles;
[*]Performance improvements;
[*]Other bug fixes.
[/list]

[h3]Next Steps[/h3]
As we mentioned on Rodrigo's character reveal, we currently have family visiting us for some time, so development of new content will be a bit slower for a while.

We are planning some smaller updates for this period, to introduce some new mechanics and systems into the game. These updates will come along with new stages for the Beach as we expand the area even further.

We are also going to work on the last stages of the Forest, to complete the area, introducing its last challenges and boss.

We hope everyone is looking forward to it

notes.title: Farmer is here! - v0.2.0
notes.content:
Hi everyone! 

Thank you for the wait. The new content is here!

[h3]Patch Notes - v0.2.0[/h3]

[h2]New Character[/h2]
[h3]Agriana, the Farmer[/h3]
A new character is joining the roster! The Farmer is bringing a new playstyle with her.

Agriana doesn't have a basic attack from the start. She starts with her Special Command, Watering Can, as her only source of damage on level 1. To fight enemies, Agriana can plant Seeds after acquiring their related Skills upon levelling up and water them with her Special Command to make them grow. Fully grown Crops can be harvested when the Farmer passes over them, which turns them into weapons and a Basic Attack for Agriana. 

Crop weapons have a certain amount of uses and they break after they are all spent. Agriana is capable of holding at least 3 weapons from the start. Weapons will be lined up in the order they are harvested and as soon as they break, Agriana will start using the next available one instantly. Crops don't vanish after being planted, so make sure to have a lot of Crops in the battlefield so you will NEVER be out of a weapon.

Each Crop weapon has its own unique characteristics and play styles, so make sure to explore all of the options!

[h2]Village[/h2]
[h3]New Addition[/h3]
New buildings have been added to the Village, while the meta progression has been changed for a few of the existing ones.

The Bank will be available to all players upon starting the game and it can be upgraded to further improve the Gold collected through runs. The Bank requires mostly gold and a very low amount of materials to upgrade.

The Farm is also included, after finding Agriana. Rebuilding the Farm will unlock her. In a future upgrade, the Farm will bring its own system in the meta progression, with a way of gathering existing materials and even exclusive new ones.

[h3]Adjustments to the Cost of Upgrades[/h3]
[list]
[*]Reduced the overall material requirements and gold for the levels that require Grassland materials. This was changed for all buildings.
[/list]

[h3]Changes to the Meta Progression[/h3]
The upgrades of most buildings have been revised and changed to include the new system described below on their earlier levels.
A full list of all the levels for the current version can be found here: https://steamcommunity.com/app/2137760/discussions/0/5950985868237614505/

Players who have levelled beyond these points will have the new systems and stats unlocked automatically. A tutorial of the system will open only on the first time the building is used, so players that have passed the level threshold before this update will also have a chance to learn about the system.

[h3]Food System[/h3]
Through the Restaurant, the player can unlock the Kitchen alongside a new System. The Food System allows Stoverick to cook something really nice in the Village after unlocking a new recipe. Foods only need to be cooked ONCE and players will be able to equip them on special plates to further boost their runs with various effects.

[h3]Blessing System[/h3]
Through the Sculptor's Gallery, the player will unlock the Showroom and its new System. The Blessing System allows Chiselo to sculpt special statues in the Village after unlocking their design. Statues will bring their own sets of effect that will affect the game, so players can customize their experience even further.

[h3]Wood Gathering System[/h3]
In the Lumberjack Cabin, the player will be able to unlock the Wood Gathering System. Do you need more wood? Let Hatchet's friends help you by gathering more wood while you run other stages! Further levels of the building will improve their gathering rate, the storage and even unlock more areas for gathering.

[h3]Financing System[/h3]
Coming with the Bank is its own Financing System. Players will be able to invest their money in the Bank and allow it to grow at a certain interest rate per run. Further levels will improve the interest rate and storage of the Bank.

[h2]Stages[/h2]
[list]
[*]New Stages added to the Forest;
[*]New Field Materials added to the deeper parts of the Forest, after Stage 4A;
[*]New enemies added;
[*]Introducing Hazards in the Forest. Stages might have their own hazards to increase the challenge. Further areas can have their own types of hazards.
[/list]

[h2]General[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added a new song for the Forest.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug with Sculptor's Gallery where it was giving more Skill Damage than the intended amount for its upgrades.
[/list]

[h3]Next Steps[/h3]
We are going to start announcing some next steps on Major Updates like this one, so players can have some information about what is in store.

For the next update we will work on the next character. He has been teased since the Prologue version of the game and it is due time for him to make an appearance. The Fisherman will be coming! He is the next character joining the battle. He will introduce the first secret area of the game, the Beach, with new challenges, materials and things to collect. The update will also finish the last few stages of the Forest, including its boss and a special stage.

We started to design and plan the Endless Stage modes. These special stages will be added for each area, with their own challenges, so players can test their skills against endless hordes of enemies for as long as they can handle. We want players to be able to collect materials and gold as they survive through these stages. We don't have a date for these special stages yet, but we wanted to let everyone know that these are being worked on.

If you want to see more of the updates for Crafty Survivors, we usually post some of the new content on our social media on Twitter. https://twitter.com/FlannelBearGame

notes.title: For anyone having issues with Controller movement
notes.content:
We have been adjusting the game to improve overall performance and avoid any issues with controllers.

We recently found out that Steam Input can cause input delays when enabled, which might be affecting some players, leading them to experience certain problems with the movement.

Even though we edited our Settings so the game won't launch with the Steam Input, some players might have it enabled in the Library's properties anyway. We recommend disabling the Steam Input in the Properties in your Steam Library, as it could be creating conflicts with the game's controller input manager. 

We hope this helps with the movement issues some players are experience when playing with a controller and with wrong button indicators showing up in their game. For example, when playing with a PS controller and the game shows Xbox inputs.

[/list]


About the optimization applied to this patch:

Before this patch, skill colliders, enemy detectors and enemy attacks would check collisions with each other. That could really sink the performance when a lot of enemies were on the screen or when using a skill that creates multiple objects.

Caramel Drop Lvl 5 was a very good example for this behavior. When all extra puddles showed up the performance could take a hit and combined with another skill on top of it could make things even worse. Now they don’t care about each other so this doesn’t happen anymore.

The same would happen with tons of enemies that shoot projectiles as their detectors would check against each other.

We hope that these chances make the game more enjoyable for everyone!

notes.title: Crafty Survivors is OUT NOW on Early Access!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

The day is finally here! Early Access is now available! There is a new character available, more stages to conquer and further upgrades on the village, to take the characters to their next level. All the more to bring those crazy builds to life!

The Early Access is available below:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2137760/Crafty_Survivors/

We want to take this opportunity to thank everyone for their support and feedback that help shape Crafty Survivors to what it is, getting us to this point! 

Best wishes,
Flannel Bear Games


Here is a list of Patch Notes for the update version on the Early Access:
[h1]Patch Notes - Version 0.1.1[/h1]

[h2]New Character[/h2]
[h3]Axel, the Lumberjack[/h3]
A new character is joining the battlefield. Axel is bringing new mechanics to the roster, with charged attacks, resource collection and an animal companion.

Special trees will spawn on the battlefield when playing with Axel. They provide a special resource, Lumber, that can be used by some of his skills, without any cooldown between them, as long as you have Lumber left.

Axel's basic attack and some of his skills can be charged to deal devastating damage to enemies, and felling trees even faster. His basic attack can be charged while moving, but to charge up skills, Axel must cannot move around. [i][b]On Auto-casting his basic attack will always be used at maximum charge, while his skills will be cast instantly without charging as Axel would be immobile while casting, putting players at a terrible situation if they were charged.[/b][/I]

Axel is accompanied by Hatchet on the battlefield. Hatchet will collect Lumber on his own while Axel is fighting. Hatchet has his own set of skills in the set that can be used from his position, bringing a whole new build for the Lumberjack playstyle. To control his position, the Special Command Water Slide can be activated, dealing damage to enemies Hatchet hits on his way to the desired position.

[h2]New Area[/h2]
[h3]Forest[/h3]
[list]
[*]Unlocked a new area, with a different look and 8 more stages to play through;
[*]New enemies added to the area, with more health and new interactions;
[*]New materials to collect, to further improve the village.
[/list]
[h2]Characters[/h2]
[h3]Stoverick, the Chef[/h3]
[list]
[*]Icingthrower nerfed:
[list]
[*]Level 4 - Increases size of projectiles;
[*]Level 5 - Adds 2 additional projectiles in the direction aimed.
[/list][/list]
[h3]Chiselo, the Sculptor[/h3]
[list]
[*]Statues will be ready for sculpting faster. Placement animation speed has been increased;
[*]Wild Spirit buffed:
[list]
[*]Increased the number of attacks from level 1;
[*]Level 4 - Increases the size of the attack even more than before.
[/list][*]Empress of the Skies buffed:[list]
[*]Increased the number of attacks and feathers will pierce from level 1.
[/list][/list]
[h3]Sewvia, the Seamstress[/h3]
[list]
[*]Basic Attack buffed:
[list]
[*]Level 2 - Damage stops decreasing per bounce;
[*]Level 3 - Yarn ball explodes on last hit;
[*]Level 6 - Damage increases by 15% per bounce.
[/list][*]Shocking Threads buffed:
[list]
[*]Increased skill duration from level 1.
[/list][/list]

[h2]Stages[/h2]
[list]
[*]Increased the overall gold drop of all Grassland stages;
[*]New mechanic: Secret Exits.
[/list][h3]Secret Exits[/h3]
Some stage can have extra exits that can be unlocked by certain characters. These exits will take players to new stages that can have their own rewards.

[h2]Village[/h2]
[list]
[*]Further levels for all the buildings;
[*]New building for the Lumberjack;
[*]Town Hall can unlock a Reroll and Remove Systems after some upgrades.
[/list]
[h3]Reroll System[/h3]
When levelling up, players can choose to reroll their options for a fixed amount of time based on the level provided by the buildings in the Village.

[h3]Remove System[/h3]
When levelling up, players can choose to remove a fixed number of skills completely from their options for the rest of the run. Amount is based on the level provided by the buildings in the Village.

[h2]General[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added a small invulnerability time after dodging and levelling up;
[*]Enemies have a small chance of dropping a Heart that heals the player by 1 Health;
[*]Edible field materials now restore 1 Health when picked up;
[*]Added a Tutorial panel on Grasslands Stage 1 to introduce the Auto Casting mechanic. This panel will show only once;
[*]Added a Tutorial panel on Grasslands Stage 2 to introduce Field Materials. This panel will show only once.
[/list]
